glossary.note: The 25 election terms in i18n/GLOSSARY.md were checked by an anonymous Yorùbá speaker and are used here VERBATIM, tone marks included or omitted exactly as the reviewer wrote them. Several glossary entries (Iṣẹlẹ, Rira ibo, Gbe jade, Nomba siriali) carry no tone marks while the rest do — a reviewer should say whether that is intentional before this is called reviewed.

_meta.note: UI strings are a language-model draft. Yorùbá needs the subdotted letters ẹ ọ ṣ AND the combining tone marks U+0300/U+0301, which live in a different Unicode block; both are in the rebuilt web fonts but NOT in Spline Sans, which is why --display swaps to Inter for this language.
